npcs.name: Biker1
npcs.text: how the hell did you manage to speak to me??

npcs.name: Biker2
npcs.repeat_text: Unless you're just reading this in the npc data

npcs.name: Biker3
npcs.text: I guess this is an easter egg

npcs.name: Biker4
npcs.text: Does this make it more exciting if I add an agg

npcs.name: Policeman blocking beach BL
npcs.text: There's still some Sharepedo reported in the water so we can't let anyone through yet.
npcs.repeat_text: Can't let you through yet until the Sharepedo are gone. It should be safe in the morning, why don't you have an early night!

npcs.name: Car park guy 1
npcs.text: I'm the parking warden for the Celeste Harbour car park but all these bikers have decided to take it over. I can't get rid of them by myself but the police are protecting the beach so I'm on my own
npcs.repeat_text: I should have finished my shift and should be in bed by now but I can't go home until these bikers leave. You should head home too you know?

npcs.name: badman 1
npcs.text: Heh, scram kid. We're having our biker gang meetup here so get lost.
npcs.repeat_text: Isn't it a little late for a loser like you to be wandering about?

npcs.name: badman 2
npcs.text: We're called the Cool Guy Biker Gang. We're the coolest in the world..... What are you giggling at loser?
npcs.repeat_text: Why don't you go home before something bad happens?

opponents.name: Gardener Callum
opponents.meet_text: Wowee, it was a long day gardening today. I'm down for a match to let off some steam now.
opponents.rematch_text: I've got time for a rematch before my next shift.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm clearly too worn out from such a long shift.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll win when I'm fully rested.
opponents.loss_text: Even after a hard days work I can still win!

opponents.name: Engineer Allan
opponents.meet_text: As you can see, the new bulb installation went perrrrfectly today. I'm worn out from all the steps but always game for a match.
opponents.rematch_text: I won't be needing to replace the bulb any time soon so I've got time to kill.
opponents.first_win_text: That was clearly toooooo many steps today
opponents.rematch_win_text: At least I'm reaaallly good at replacing bulbs.
opponents.loss_text: I hope your loss didn't come as a shock to you.

opponents.name: Fisherman_John
opponents.meet_text: Me and my buddy Dave fish here all the time. The lighthouse is like a giant lure in the evening so we catch even more. I've got time for a break.
opponents.rematch_text: The evening is still young if you want another match.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm a much better fisherman than I am a card player.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Always happy to put my fishing aside for a rematch.
opponents.loss_text: I'm not just the best round here at fishing!

opponents.name: Painter_Jericho
opponents.meet_text: The evening sun is the most perfect time to come here and paint... or play cards!
opponents.rematch_text: I've been painting a lot of great pieces from this spot
opponents.first_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.rematch_win_text: A win or a loss, both are equal pieces of art.
opponents.loss_text: To win is a beautiful piece of art.
